title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, policy interventions, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Individuals adjust mask-use propensity based on the observed behavior and opinions of their network neighbors and household members.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Compliance checks in workplaces/schools and public spaces result in enforcement outcomes (warnings, fines) that affect future compliance.

interactions.name: purchase_transaction
interactions.description: Individuals attempt to buy masks from retailers subject to price, inventory, and personal affordability.

interactions.name: government_campaign
interactions.description: Public health messaging increases perceived efficacy and/or trust, shifting adoption propensities.

interactions.name: supply_allocation
interactions.description: Government allocates supply to retailers; retailers restock and adjust prices based on inventory.

interactions.name: workplace_policy_effect
interactions.description: Local policies at workplaces/schools increase adoption probability while on-site and can spill over to general behavior.

interactions.name: environmental_risk_signal
interactions.description: Regional prevalence signals affect individual risk perception and thus adoption decisions.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing masks each time step.

metrics.name: mean_adoption
metrics.description: Average adoption rate over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent
metrics.description: Number of time steps until 50% of the population consistently adopts masks.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed and when it occurs.

metrics.name: adoption_inequality_index
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across demographic or income groups (e.g., Gini or Theil index).

metrics.name: policy_cost
metrics.description: Aggregate cost of enforcement and campaigns.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Total number of enforcement events (warnings, fines).

metrics.name: stockout_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of time retailers have zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: spillover_persistence
metrics.description: Degree to which policy-induced adoption persists after mandates are lifted.
